overview.Module Title: Chinese Marxism and the Contemporary Era

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module serves both as a compulsory Ideological and Political Theory course for doctoral students and as an elective Ideological and Political Theory course for master's students. It aims to equip doctoral candidates from diverse disciplinary backgrounds with theoretical frameworks and analytical approaches rooted in Contemporary Chinese Marxism and 21st-century Marxism, enabling them to understand, analyze, and interpret major issues concerning China and the world. As a postgraduate public course with broad thematic coverage, the module emphasises Chinese characteristics, a global perspective, and a strong sense of contemporary responsibility. The course adopts a problem-oriented approach, strengthening students’ awareness of real-world issues and enhancing their capacity for critical analysis and problem-solving. 本课程同时作为博士生思想政治理论必修课和硕士生思政政治理论选修课。作为一门内容涉及广泛，又要求体现中国特色、世界视野和时代情怀的研究生公共课，本课程致力于为不同专业门类的博士生提供运用当代中国马克思主义、21世纪马克思主义了解、分析和阐发中国与世界各种问题的方法及思考。在当代中国与世界的关系已经发生历史性变化的时代条件下，我国青年必须站在准备把握中国与世界全新关系的高度，从时代潮流和时代要求上确立自己的时代使命，特别是运用马克思主义的立场、观点和方法进行观察、理解和思考。本课程围绕博士研究生的理论需求，坚持问题导向，强化问题意识，致力于提高博士研究生分析问题和解决问题的能力，坚定马克思主义的信仰，中国特色社会主义的信念，实现中华民族伟大复兴中国梦的信心。
sections.Learning outcomes: A Apply Contemporary Chinese Marxism and 21st-century Marxism to analyze major issues concerning China and the world. 运用当代中国马克思主义和21世纪马克思主义分析中国与世界的重大问题。 B Critically understand global economic, political, social, cultural, ecological, and technological developments, with a focus on China’s role. 批判性理解当代世界在经济、政治、社会、文化、生态与科技领域的发展及中国角色。 C Develop an ideological position and a sense of academic responsibility in the context of China’s development and global change. 在中国发展与全球变局背景下，形成坚定的思想认同与学术责任意识。
sections.Method of teaching and learning: CCT407 is a compulsory module prescribed by the Ministry of Education for doctoral students. It is delivered via an online MOOC platform as a high-quality course recorded and taught by academic staff from Fudan University. In addition to this module, mainland Chinese doctoral students at XJTLU are required to take either CCT401 or CCT402 as a compulsory elective. For this module, students are required to complete all learning activities within one semester, including: - Viewing and studying all online course videos (with a total duration of approximately 10.5 hours), which account for 40% of the final grade and are assessed according to the proportion completed; - Completing the online quizzes, which serve as the final examination. The system allows two attempts, and the higher score will be counted towards the final grade as a measure of learning effectiveness. This module is designed to provide mainland Chinese doctoral students at XJTLU with relevant theoretical and practical knowledge, and to support them in applying contemporary Chinese Marxism and Marxism for the 21st century to understand, analyse and interpret a wide range of issues concerning China and the wider world. Its flexible format makes it suitable for students with diverse learning needs and time commitments. CCT407 是一门面向博士生、由教育部规定的必修课程，通过线上 MOOC 平台开设，是复旦大学教师录制的精品在线课程。除本课程外，西浦大陆籍博士研究生还需在 CCT401 和 CCT402 中任选一门作为必选选修课进行学习。 关于本课程，学生需在一学期内完成本课程的全部学习内容，包括： 1.观看并学习全部线上课程视频（总时长约 10.5 小时，占课程总成绩的 40%，根据完成比例计分）； 2.完成线上测验（Quiz）作为期末考试，系统提供两次作答机会，取最高成绩计入总评，以此检验学习效果。 本课程旨在为西浦大陆籍博士系统提供相关理论与实践方面的知识，帮助他们学习运用当代中国马克思主义、21世纪马克思主义了解、分析和阐发中国与世界各种问题的方法及思考，课程形式灵活，适用于不同学习需求与时间安排的学生。
